5 Proven Benefits of Asphalt Shingle Roofing for Allentown

3 May 2025 Asphalt Shingle Roofing

In Allentown, PA, the seasons are diverse, snowy winters, humid summers, and stormy springs. Homeowners here need roofing that can handle it all without costing a fortune. That’s why the benefits of asphalt shingle roofing make it the go-to solution for homes across the Lehigh Valley.

Whether your home is near Trexler Park, Cedar Beach, or just off Hamilton Boulevard, asphalt shingles deliver on performance, affordability, and style. They’re easy to install, look great, and are built to last in Allentown’s unpredictable weather. Below, we dive into the five biggest advantages of using asphalt shingles for your roof.

Boosts Curb Appeal in Any Neighborhood

Versatile Styles and Colors

Asphalt shingles are available in countless styles and shades, from earthy browns and grays to bold, architectural designs. This gives homeowners the flexibility to match or upgrade their home’s look affordably.

Whether your house is a Victorian-style home near the Old Allentown Historic District or a modern suburban build in the South Mountain area, asphalt shingles can complement its exterior beautifully.

Enhances Property Value

A well-maintained asphalt shingle roof can significantly boost your home’s market value. First impressions matter, and a fresh, uniform roof makes a property more appealing to buyers.

Many real estate agents in Allentown report quicker sales and better offers on homes with newer shingle roofs. It’s an investment that truly pays off.

Excellent Weather Resistance for Pennsylvania Seasons

Handles Snow, Rain, and Heat with Ease

Allentown gets everything from heavy snow to intense summer heat. Asphalt shingles are built with this variety in mind. They resist water, reflect sunlight, and shed snow efficiently, helping keep your home safe and dry all year long.

UV and Wind Resistance

Modern asphalt shingles come with added protection against UV rays, which can wear down roofing materials over time. They also have high wind ratings, able to withstand gusts up to 130 mph, an important feature during spring thunderstorms or the occasional Nor’easter.

Cost-Effective Without Compromising Quality

Budget-Friendly for Homeowners

Of all the roofing materials available, asphalt shingles offer one of the best value-for-money options. Their lower material cost, ease of installation, and long lifespan make them ideal for Allentown homeowners looking to upgrade on a budget.

Shingles provide the perfect balance between affordability and quality, and they don’t skimp on style either to experience the benefits of asphalt shingle roofing.

Long Lifespan with Proper Maintenance

With good care, asphalt shingle roofs can last 20 to 30 years. Regular inspections and minor repairs can go a long way in preserving their condition. For homeowners in neighborhoods like West End, it’s a durable choice that won’t require frequent replacement.

Quick and Easy Installation Saves Time and Money

Faster Turnaround Times

One of the most underrated benefits of asphalt shingle roofing is the quick installation. Most jobs can be completed in just a few days, great news for families with tight schedules or emergency roof repairs.

This fast turnaround reduces disruption and lets you return to daily life sooner.

Less Labor, Lower Costs

Because asphalt shingles are lightweight and easy to work with, installation doesn’t require complex tools or extra manpower. This reduces labor costs and minimizes the time contractors spend on your property.

If you’re dealing with storm damage or simply want a quick upgrade, this benefit is hard to beat.

Looking to upgrade your roof fast? Visit our Asphalt Shingle Roofing page to learn more about services tailored for Allentown homes and understand the benefits of asphalt shingle roofing.

Eco-Friendly and Energy Efficient Options Available

Reflective Shingles Reduce Heat

Energy-efficient asphalt shingles are now widely available. These are coated with reflective granules that reduce heat absorption and help maintain cooler indoor temperatures, especially during Allentown’s hot, humid summers.

This leads to lower utility bills and a more comfortable home environment.

Recyclable Materials Help the Environment

Concerned about your environmental footprint? Many asphalt shingles are made from recycled materials and can be recycled again at the end of their life. That’s a sustainable choice without sacrificing quality or style.

Local Trust and Roofing Expertise in Allentown

Experience with Allentown Neighborhoods

At In The Light Roofing, we’ve proudly served families and businesses throughout Allentown, from the tree-lined streets near Lehigh Parkway to the bustling areas near the PPL Center.

Our understanding of local architecture, permitting regulations, and seasonal weather patterns gives us a clear advantage when helping customers choose the right roof.

Trusted by Local Families and Businesses

We’ve earned the trust of your neighbors through honesty, hard work, and quality craftsmanship. When you hire a local roofing expert, you’re not just getting materials, you’re getting personalized service from a team that understands what your home really needs so that you can experience the benefits of asphalt shingle roofing.

Conclusion: Why Asphalt Shingles Are a Smart Choice

When it comes to roofing, Allentown homeowners want durability, affordability, and style. That’s exactly what asphalt shingles offer.

The benefits of asphalt shingle roofing make it a top-tier choice for the unique demands of Allentown homes. From weather resistance and curb appeal to fast installation and green benefits, shingles check all the boxes.

Ready to protect your home with a reliable roof that looks great and saves you money? Contact In The Light Roofing today for a consultation or visit us in Allentown!

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the average lifespan of asphalt shingles?

With proper care, most asphalt shingles last between 20 and 30 years.

Are asphalt shingles a good fit for Allentown’s weather?

Absolutely. They perform well in snow, rain, heat, and strong winds, perfect for Pennsylvania’s changing seasons. The benefits of asphalt shingle roofing proves to be perfect fit for your home.

Do asphalt shingles come in many colors?

Yes! You can choose from traditional colors like black, gray, and brown, or go bold with reds, greens, and blues.

Are asphalt shingles easy to repair?

Yes. Repairs are generally quick and affordable compared to other roofing materials.

Can I install asphalt shingles over an old roof?

Sometimes. It depends on the condition of your existing roof and local building codes. We’ll assess and advise during your consultation.

Why work with In The Light Roofing?

We combine expert craftsmanship with local knowledge and transparent pricing. Your satisfaction is our top priority.
